title: POST /Account/v1/User response
description: Response shape for account creation, used by BookStoreApiTest Test 1 (createAccount_ShouldReturnUserIdAndUsername). Deliberately does not require/type-check 'books' beyond 'array' — a freshly created account's books list is always empty in practice, but nothing about account creation guarantees that will stay true, and the field-by-field Hamcrest assertions in the test are what actually check the specific values (userID non-empty, username matches) — this schema's job is just to catch the response's overall SHAPE changing, e.g. 'userID' disappearing or becoming a number.
